property_sets.name: Reviera_GlazingUnit
property_sets.description: A glazing build-up's light, thermal and safety values (spec ARC-GLZ-003), on glazing types: sloped glazing roof types and curtain wall types. Typical values come from Reviera's glazing library and are replaced by the specified product's.

properties.name: VisibleTransmittance
properties.description: Share of visible light the glazing lets through at normal incidence.

properties.name: ParTransmittance
properties.description: Share of photosynthetically active radiation (400–700 nm) let through, for crop-light analysis.

properties.name: Haze
properties.description: Share of the transmitted light that is diffused (horticultural diffuse glass, multiwall sheet).

properties.name: ThermalTransmittance
properties.description: Centre-of-pane U-value.

properties.name: SolarHeatGainCoefficient
properties.description: Total solar energy transmittance (g-value).

properties.name: SafetyClass
properties.description: How the glazing breaks.

properties.name: Interlayer
properties.description: A laminate's interlayer thickness (0.38 mm, 0.76 mm …).

properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: The glazing's overall thickness.

properties.name: MassPerArea
properties.description: Weight per area of glazing (stored with the per-length measure, as IFC has no per-area mass measure).

properties.name: MinimumPitch
properties.description: The least roof pitch the glazing is laid at.

properties.name: Structure
properties.description: Multiwall sheet's or film's structure: twin-wall, five-wall, multi-skin, single film, double inflated film.

property_sets.name: Reviera_FrameSystem
property_sets.description: A glazing frame system's material, glazing bar section and the deflection limit of its members carrying glass (spec ARC-GLZ-003), on frame types and on glazing types made on the frame. Typical values come from Reviera's frame library and are replaced by the specified system's.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: The members' material.

properties.name: Finish
properties.description: The members' finish (mill finish, anodised, hot-dip galvanised, stained, white …).

properties.name: BarWidth
properties.description: The glazing bar's width across the glazing's face.

properties.name: BarDepth
properties.description: The glazing bar's depth through the glazing.

properties.name: DeflectionRatio
properties.description: Members carrying glass deflect at most their span divided by this (175 for L/175).

properties.name: MaximumDeflection
properties.description: An absolute cap on that deflection, when the system sets one.

property_sets.name: Reviera_Vent
property_sets.description: A ventilation opening's design values (spec ARC-GLZ-004): on a vent window, that vent's; on a roof or curtain wall with vents, their count and totals. Free area is the opening of a top-hung sash at its design angle (the slot under it and its two side triangles, at most the pane); effective area is that times the discharge coefficient.

properties.name: OpeningAngle
properties.description: The design opening angle.

properties.name: DischargeCoefficient
properties.description: Effective over free area.

properties.name: Actuator
properties.description: How the vent is opened.

properties.name: FreeArea
properties.description: The geometric opening at the design angle (a host's: its vents' sum).

properties.name: EffectiveArea
properties.description: The free area times the discharge coefficient (a host's: its vents' sum).

properties.name: VentCount
properties.description: On a host: how many vents it has.

property_sets.name: Reviera_EnclosureDesign
property_sets.description: A glazed enclosure's design values (spec ARC-GLZ-001, -002), on its IfcElementAssembly (ObjectType GlazedEnclosure).

properties.name: Form
properties.description: The form.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Along the ridges.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Across the spans.

properties.name: Span
properties.description: Each roof's span (a Venlo's narrow roof).

properties.name: Spans
properties.description: How many roofs side by side.

properties.name: BaySpacing
properties.description: The bays along the length.

properties.name: EaveHeight
properties.description: The eave (gutter) height above the level; a tunnel's sidewall.

properties.name: RidgeHeight
properties.description: The highest ridge or crown above the level.

properties.name: Pitch
properties.description: The roof slope (not for tunnels).

properties.name: FloorArea
properties.description: Length times width.

properties.name: RoofVentTarget
properties.description: Roof vents' target area over the floor area.

properties.name: SideVentTarget
properties.description: Side vents' target area over the floor area.

property_sets.name: Reviera_GrowingClimate
property_sets.description: A glazed enclosure's growing climate (spec ARC-GLZ-008), on its IfcElementAssembly (ObjectType GlazedEnclosure): a crop preset's set points or the designer's.

properties.name: Crop
properties.description: The crop the climate is for.

properties.name: TargetDailyLightIntegral
properties.description: The daily light integral the crop is grown to, natural light and lamps together.

properties.name: DayTemperature
properties.description: The day air temperature set point.

properties.name: NightTemperature
properties.description: The night air temperature set point.

properties.name: RelativeHumidityMin
properties.description: The least relative humidity.

properties.name: RelativeHumidityMax
properties.description: The most relative humidity.

properties.name: CarbonDioxideSetpoint
properties.description: The CO2 concentration held with the vents shut.

properties.name: Photoperiod
properties.description: Hours of light a day, lamps included.

property_sets.name: Reviera_GrowLight
property_sets.description: Supplemental grow lighting (spec ARC-GLZ-009): on each grow light (IfcLightFixture, ObjectType GrowLight) its photon output and power; on a grow-light layout (IfcElementAssembly, ObjectType GrowLightLayout) its count and design values.

properties.name: PhotonFlux
properties.description: The fixture's photosynthetic photon flux, 400–700 nm.

properties.name: ElectricalPower
properties.description: The fixture's input power.

properties.name: PhotonEfficacy
properties.description: Photon flux over input power (PPE).

properties.name: FixtureCount
properties.description: On a layout: how many fixtures.

properties.name: TargetPPFD
properties.description: On a layout: the mean photosynthetic photon flux density laid out for.

properties.name: AveragePPFD
properties.description: On a layout: the fixtures' maintained photons over the growing floor.

properties.name: PowerDensity
properties.description: On a layout: the fixtures' power over the growing floor.

properties.name: MaintenanceFactor
properties.description: On a layout: the output kept after lamp ageing and dirt.

property_sets.name: Reviera_Screen
property_sets.description: A greenhouse energy, shade or blackout screen (spec ARC-GLZ-010), on its IfcShadingDevice (ObjectType EnergyScreen, ShadeScreen or BlackoutScreen). Typical values from Reviera's screen library, to be replaced by the specified product's.

properties.name: Kind
properties.description: What the screen is for.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: The screen material.

properties.name: LightTransmission
properties.description: Share of light let through when closed.

properties.name: EnergySaving
properties.description: Share of the heating energy saved while closed (published, at night).

properties.name: Porous
properties.description: Air passes through the fabric.

property_sets.name: Reviera_Elevator
property_sets.description: An elevator's sizes and drive as Reviera sized them (spec ARC-VT-002), on the car (IfcTransportElement ELEVATOR). IFC's Pset_TransportElementCommon and Pset_TransportElementElevator hold its capacity and clear car size; these are the values they lack. A chosen product's own values replace them.

properties.name: RatedSpeed
properties.description: Rated speed.

properties.name: DriveType
properties.description: How the car is driven.

properties.name: DoorOperation
properties.description: How the car and landing doors open: to one side, or from the centre.

properties.name: DoorClearWidth
properties.description: Clear width of the car and landing doors.

properties.name: DoorClearHeight
properties.description: Clear height of the car and landing doors.

properties.name: HoistwayWidth
properties.description: Inside width of the hoistway.

properties.name: HoistwayDepth
properties.description: Inside depth of the hoistway.

properties.name: PitDepth
properties.description: From the lowest landing's floor down to the pit floor.

properties.name: Overhead
properties.description: From the top landing's floor up to the underside of the structure above the hoistway.

properties.name: StopsServed
properties.description: How many levels the elevator serves.

properties.name: SizingPack
properties.description: The vertical-transport rule pack the sizes came from (ARC-VT-001), until a product replaces them.

properties.name: Kind
properties.description: What the elevator or lift is for.

properties.name: LoadingClass
properties.description: A freight car's loading class (ASME A17.1 2.16.2.2).

properties.name: MotorPower
properties.description: Motor power: a planning estimate from the load and speed (ARC-VT-007) until the maker's figure replaces it.

properties.name: FullLoadCurrent
properties.description: Full-load current at the supply voltage (planning estimate).

properties.name: SupplyVoltage
properties.description: Supply voltage.

properties.name: HeatRelease
properties.description: Heat released into the machine space or hoistway (planning estimate) for its ventilation or cooling.

property_sets.name: Reviera_Escalator
property_sets.description: An escalator's or moving walk's sizes as Reviera sized them (spec ARC-VT-010), on the IfcTransportElement (ESCALATOR or MOVINGWALKWAY). Pset_TransportElementCommon holds its capacity (persons per hour). A chosen product's own values replace these.

properties.name: Rise
properties.description: Between the lower and upper landings (0 for a horizontal walk).

properties.name: Inclination
properties.description: Of the steps or pallets.

properties.name: StepWidth
properties.description: Nominal step or pallet width.

properties.name: Speed
properties.description: Rated speed.

properties.name: FlatSteps
properties.description: Flat steps at each landing (0 for a walk).

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Plan length between the truss ends.

properties.name: TrussWidth
properties.description: Width of the truss.

properties.name: PitDepth
properties.description: Depth of the pits below the floors (0 for a walk on the floor).

properties.name: MotorPower
properties.description: Planning estimate from the rise, width and speed (ARC-VT-010) until the maker's figure replaces it.

properties.name: SupportReactionLower
properties.description: Planning estimate of the reaction at the lower end support.

properties.name: SupportReactionUpper
properties.description: Planning estimate of the reaction at the upper end support.

properties.name: SizingPack
properties.description: The vertical-transport rule pack the sizes came from (ARC-VT-010).
